quarterly_data.quarter: Digital Realty press release: Digital Realty Selected to Develop 50 Megawatts of New Data (08-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Digital Realty was selected under Singapore's second Data Center Call for Application (DC-CFA2) with a provisional allocation of 50 megawatts (MW) of capacity to develop a new data center at Jurong Town Corporation's low-carbon data center park on Jurong Island - its fourth Singapore data center, planned as AI-ready capacity for AI inference, high-performance computing and enterprise workloads and designed to power more than 50% of its capacity through green energy pathways. Digital Realty currently operates three data centers in Singapore with approximately 84 MW of combined capacity. No construction start, completion date or investment amount stated.
quarterly_data.figure: 50 MW provisional allocation (Jurong Island, Singapore); existing Singapore capacity approximately 84 MW across three data centers
